Container.Name: readarr-redux
Container.Overview: Readarr Redux is an unofficial continuation of Readarr, the ebook and audiobook manager for Usenet and BitTorrent users, which the Servarr team retired in June 2025. It runs against a metadata source you choose (for example your own rreading-glasses) and fixes the bugs that made Readarr lose books.[br][br] It is a drop-in for the linuxserver.io Readarr container: point it at a copy of an existing Readarr appdata folder to move over. Back the folder up first; the move can't be undone without the backup.[br][br] Until a login is set up, the web UI asks for a one-time setup code, which Readarr prints to the container log at every start.[br][br] Not affiliated with or supported by the Servarr team.
Container.Requires: A metadata source for books, such as rreading-glasses (https://github.com/blampe/rreading-glasses). Readarr Redux has no default one.

Config.Name: Books
Config.Description: Your ebook and audiobook library. Add it as a root folder in Settings > Media Management.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where your download client puts finished downloads. Use the same container path as in the download client's container, or set a remote path mapping.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Readarr runs as. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID Readarr runs as. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, for example Europe/London. Leave blank to use UTC.
